summary: This class discusses the custom of reciting certain chapters of Tehilim on Purim and fast days, referencing the Abudarham and other sources. It covers the different customs of reciting Lamnatse'ah 'al Ayelet Hashahar and Shir Hama'alot on Purim, as well as the customs regarding fast days and a bet avel.
questions: Which chapters of Tehilim are recited on Purim?
When did Rabbi David Abudarham document the custom of reciting the 22nd chapter of Tehilim for Purim?
How do the customs of Halab and New York differ regarding the recitation of Lamnatse'ah 'al Ayelet Hashahar on Purim?
Do communities recite special mizmorim on fast days like Ta'anit Ester, Tsom Gedalyah, 'Asarah BeTevet, and Shiva' 'Asar BeTammuz?
Which mizmor is recited in a house of mourning and when is it said?
